name: io.github.publicdotcom/publicdotcom-mcp-server
title: Public.com Trading API
description: Connect AI assistants to your Public.com brokerage account. Trade stocks, options, and crypto — get quotes, manage orders, and view your portfolio.

environment_variables.name: PUBLIC_COM_SECRET
environment_variables.description: Your Public.com API secret key. Get one at https://public.com/settings/v2/api

environment_variables.name: PUBLIC_COM_ACCOUNT_ID
environment_variables.description: Default account ID. Optional — if not set, the server will prompt for it.

environment_variables.name: PUBLIC_COM_ORDER_CONFIRMATION
environment_variables.description: How orders are confirmed: auto (default) asks the user through MCP elicitation when the client supports it; required refuses orders from clients that cannot ask; off never asks.

environment_variables.name: PUBLIC_COM_MAX_ORDER_QUANTITY
environment_variables.description: Optional. Refuse any order for more shares or contracts than this.

environment_variables.name: PUBLIC_COM_MAX_ORDER_VALUE
environment_variables.description: Optional. Refuse any order whose preflight order value, estimated cost or buying power requirement is over this many dollars.

environment_variables.name: PUBLIC_COM_READ_ONLY
environment_variables.description: Optional. Set to true to remove every order-placing and cancelling tool.
